integrity.computational_verification: 275 finite checks, not a proof of infinite quantifiers.
integrity.proof_scope: Strict likelihood-ratio ordering and conditional far-radius Gaussian limit, with two conditional moment asymptotics.
integrity.unproved_limits: No parameter-uniform endpoints, non-Poisson extension or independent mathematical audit.

scientific_limitations: Fixed eventwise killing probability strictly between zero and one; isotropic independent orientations; exponential event times; fixed positive speed; conditioning at positive radius; asymptotics for fixed parameters only. Historical equivalents may exist.
title: Radial inference of the killing index in a planar random flight
